import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int infinity = 1000000009;
    static int source, sink;
    static List<List<Integer>> G;
    static List<Edge> e;
    static int[] ptr = new int[1001];
    static int[] dist = new int[1001];
    static String[] scientists = new String[101];
    static String[] reactors = new String[101];
    static boolean[][][][] isReachable = new boolean[10][10][10][10];
    static int[][] visited = new int[101][101];
    static int[][] becomesUnusableAt = new int[10][10];
    static int n, m;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, capacity;

        Edge(int u, int v, int flow, int capacity) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        G.get(u).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, capacity));
        G.get(v).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static boolean findPath() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.offer(source);
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = Q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < G.get(u).size(); ++i) {
                int id = G.get(u).get(i);
                int v = e.get(id).v;
                if (dist[v] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).capacity) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    Q.offer(v);
                    if (v == sink)
                        return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long sendFlow(int u, long flow) {
        if (flow == 0)
            return 0;
        if (u == sink)
            return flow;
        for (; ptr[u] < G.get(u).size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            int id = G.get(u).get(ptr[u]);
            int v = e.get(id).v;
            if (dist[v] != dist[u] + 1)
                continue;
            long pushed = sendFlow(v, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).capacity - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed != 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long dinics() {
        long flow = 0;
        while (findPath()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                long pushed = sendFlow(source, infinity);
                if (pushed == 0)
                    break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static boolean isValid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
    }

    static int getID(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + m * x + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        ++T;
        m = n;
        sink = m * m + m * m + 1;
        source = 0;
        G = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m * m * 2 + 2; ++i) {
            G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        e = new ArrayList<>();
        Queue<int[]> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            scientists[i] = sc.next();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            reactors[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                becomesUnusableAt[i][j] = infinity;
                if (reactors[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    Q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    becomesUnusableAt[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = Q.peek()[0];
            int y = Q.poll()[1];
            for (int i = -1; i <= 1; ++i) {
                for (int j = -1; j <= 1; ++j) {
                    if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) == 1) {
                        int nx = x + i;
                        int ny = y + j;
                        if (isValid(nx, ny) && becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] == infinity && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                            becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] = becomesUnusableAt[x][y] + 1;
                            Q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; ++y) {
                if (scientists[x].charAt(y) >= '1' && scientists[x].charAt(y) <= '9') {
                    addEdge(source, getID(x, y), scientists[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                if (reactors[x].charAt(y) >= '1' && reactors[x].charAt(y) <= '9') {
                    addEdge(n * n + getID(x, y), sink, reactors[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                for (int X = 0; X < n; ++X) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; ++Y) {
                        if (scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' ||
                            reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Y' || reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Z') {
                            continue;
                        }
                        Arrays.fill(visited[0], 0);
                        Queue<int[]> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                        queue.offer(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        visited[x][y] = 1;
                        boolean found = false;
                        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                            int cx = queue.peek()[0];
                            int cy = queue.peek()[1];
                            int tim = queue.poll()[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                visited[cx][cy] = 1;
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (tim >= becomesUnusableAt[cx][cy] || tim >= T) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            for (int i = -1; i <= 1; ++i) {
                                for (int j = -1; j <= 1; ++j) {
                                    if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) == 1) {
                                        int nx = cx + i;
                                        int ny = cy + j;
                                        if (isValid(nx, ny) && visited[nx][cy] == 0 &&
                                            scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' &&
                                            scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Z' &&
                                            tim + 1 <= becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny]) {
                                            visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                                            queue.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, tim + 1});
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (visited[X][Y] == 1) {
                            addEdge(getID(x, y), n * n + getID(X, Y), infinity);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int ans = (int) dinics();
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
